title: 第15章 自相残杀第16章 鬼脸
slug: 聚宝仙锅第1038章天龟肆虐
content_zh:
一般的探宝之旅，大家一定是争先恐后，生怕宝物被别人先抢走。
可是生性异常谨慎的李凡，却不这么认为。
争先恐后，确实得到宝物的可能性大一点，同样风险一样大增。
李凡可不是舍命不舍财的主儿。
宝物，这次得不到，下次还有机会。
小命，却只有一条，失去了，就万劫不复，甚至和志南和尚一般，连个收尸的都没有。
韩冬三人鱼贯而入，李凡找一个断后的借口，却是立即向后寻觅而去。
走出几丈远，终于让李凡发现一团黑影。
李凡拿出一块月亮石。
“小狗？”
李凡喃喃的说。
这团黑影，竟然是一只仅有巴掌大小的小黑狗。
小黑狗胖乎乎的样子，小腿显得十分短小，此时，竟然在呼呼大睡，精致的小嘴巴竟然有一个气泡，随着呼吸在忽大忽小的变化。
十分可爱！
可是，此时的李凡，却有一点惊奇。
刚才，这只小黑狗明明是被几把飞剑刺中，可是现在呢，小黑狗身上看不到一点伤痕。
甚至，小黑狗的毛发都没有一点褶皱的痕迹。
这只小黑狗绝对不简单！
李凡释放出中品法器寒冰剑，单手一点，飞剑划出一道美丽的弧线，刺在小黑狗的肚皮上。
没有穿透身体的声音，威力十足的中品法器，竟然直接弹飞。

而小黑狗的肚皮上的，甚至没有留下一丝印记。
只是试探一下，李凡将小黑狗收到灵兽袋中。
幸亏李凡未雨绸缪，准备一个灵兽袋，如今正好派上用场。
小心翼翼的穿过石门，这是一间十分宽敞的客厅。
可是，客厅里的装饰品，还有桌椅等等，年代久远，已经几乎全部变成粉末。
韩冬三人，似乎十分不甘心，还在继续搜寻。
不过，这个客厅，似乎只是会客用的，根本没有任何有价值的东西。
“哎！可惜了志南道友的一条性命，却什么都没有得到。”
韩冬显得十分无奈。
韩冬三人准备撤出去，李凡却依旧说道，“各位道友，我来断后！”
“李道友大义！”
还是同样的对话。
韩冬三人撤出客厅，从石门的缝隙出去。
李凡呢，却开始一轮自己的搜寻。
本着绝不浪费的性格，李凡翻一遍客厅里的废品。
“咦？”
李凡却找到一个奇特的小碗。
小碗周身是一种不知名的玉石，即使经历过漫长的岁月，依旧还有一点光泽。
只是，小碗周身上下没有一点灵气波动，所以，韩冬三人都没有在意。
时间紧迫，李凡将小碗，还有一段破木头，全部收进储物袋，这才跟上前面三人。

“哎，这位李道友果然如同韩道友所说，是废品收购的店主，什么东西，都不肯放过。”
张道士有点嘲讽的说。
韩冬微微一笑。
content_en:
On a normal treasure hunting trip, everyone must be scrambling for fear that the treasure will be snatched away by others first.
But Li Fan, who is extremely cautious by nature, doesn't think so.
If you rush to be the first, the possibility of actually getting the treasure is higher, but the risk is also greatly increased.
Li Fan is not a master who would rather give up his life than his wealth.
If you can't get the treasure this time, you will have a chance next time.
There is only one life, but if it is lost, it will be irreversible. Even like monk Zhinan, there is no one to collect the body.
Han Dong and the other three filed in. Li Fan found an excuse to stop, but immediately went back to look for them.
After walking a few feet away, Li Fan finally spotted a dark shadow.
Li Fan took out a moon stone.
"Puppy?"
Li Fan murmured.
This black shadow turned out to be a small black dog only the size of a palm.
The little black dog looked chubby and had very short legs. At this time, he was sleeping soundly. There was an air bubble in his delicate little mouth, which changed in size and size with his breathing.
Very cute!
However, Li Fan was a little surprised at this time.
Just now, the little black dog was obviously stabbed by several flying swords, but now, there is no scar on the little black dog.
There wasn't even a trace of wrinkles on the little black dog's hair.
This little black dog is definitely not simple!
Li Fan released the middle-grade magic weapon Ice Sword. With one hand, the flying sword drew a beautiful arc and stabbed the little black dog in the belly.
There was no sound that penetrated the body, and the powerful mid-grade magic weapon bounced away directly.
But there wasn't even a trace left on the little black dog's belly.
Just to test it out, Li Fan put the little black dog into the spirit beast bag.
Fortunately, Li Fan took precautions and prepared a spirit beast bag, which came in handy now.
Passing through the stone door carefully, this is a very spacious living room.
However, the decorations in the living room, as well as tables and chairs, etc., have almost all turned into powder over time.
Han Dong and the other three seemed very unwilling to do so and continued to search.
However, this living room seems to be only used for entertaining guests, and there is nothing of value at all.
"Hey! It's a pity that fellow Taoist Zhinan lost his life, but got nothing."
Han Dong looked very helpless.
Han Dong and the others were about to withdraw, but Li Fan still said, "Fellow Taoists, I will cut off the rear!"
"Fellow Daoist Li is righteous!"
Still the same conversation.
Han Dong and the others withdrew from the living room and went out through the gap in the stone door.
As for Li Fan, he started his own search.
In line with his character of never wasting anything, Li Fan went through the waste products in the living room.
"Huh?"
Li Fan found a strange small bowl.
The small bowl is surrounded by an unknown jade stone, which still has a little luster even after a long period of time.
However, there was no spiritual energy fluctuation around Xiao Wan's body, so Han Dong and the others didn't pay attention.
Time was running out, so Li Fan put the small bowl and a piece of broken wood into his storage bag before following the three in front.
"Hey, this Fellow Daoist Li is just like what Fellow Daoist Han said, he is a shop owner who buys scraps. He won't let go of anything."
Taoist Zhang said a little sarcastically.
Han Dong smiled slightly.
